[SWS_DM_00910] Support of Subfunction 0x02 (OFF)
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04180, RS_Diag_04159
⌈
If the
Diagnostic Server instance
receives a valid UDS service ControlDTC-
Setting (0x85) with Subfunction 0x02 (OFF) and optionally with DTCSettingControlOp-
tionRecord of value 0xFFFFFF, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall:
• disable the update of the
UDS DTC status bytes
in the primary
event mem-
ory
and all user defined event memories with
DiagnosticMemoryDestina-
tionUserDefined.affectedByControlDTCSetting
set to true or not con-
figured
• disable the storage in the primary
event memory
and all user defined event
memories with
DiagnosticMemoryDestinationUserDefined.affected-
ByControlDTCSetting
set to true or not configured
• update
ara::diag::ControlDtcStatusType
to
kDTCSettingOff
⌋
